summary: RuneScape entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: RuneScape

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC client at current graphics settings

primary.version: Current RuneScape client / Steam or Jagex Launcher
primary.why: RuneScape began as a Java browser MMORPG and is now a live service with standalone PC and mobile clients. The Windows PC route has the strongest interface, graphics, input, and capture ceiling; mobile is useful for account continuity but not the main archive route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows client through Jagex Launcher or Steam with the account state being archived. Record date, client version, graphics mode, and major live update context.

all_releases.platform: Java browser original / RuneScape Classic lineage
all_releases.fidelity: Historical browser route for the original MMORPG lineage.
all_releases.reason: skip: historical state rather than the current live-service route; do not conflate with the maintained current client.

all_releases.fidelity: Standalone PC client with best interface, graphics, input, and capture flexibility.
all_releases.reason: primary: best current route for a live RuneScape archive session.

all_releases.fidelity: Desktop alternates for the same live service.
all_releases.reason: skip: useful system alternates; no sourced content advantage over Windows for capture.

all_releases.fidelity: Mobile route for the same account/service with touch interface constraints.
all_releases.reason: skip: useful on-the-go route, but not the primary capture/interface path for the archive.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The historical browser state and current live client are not the same preserved experience. For the archive, use current PC for a live-service run and treat RuneScape Classic/Old School as separate historical research lanes.

entries.remaster_caveats: Old School RuneScape is a separately maintained 2007-era branch and should be its own entry. This entry covers the main current RuneScape service.
